title: Outstanding Transaction Counter Overflow
description: The crossbar allows more than the maximum outstanding transactions (N=4) because the counter uses a 2-bit register that wraps from 3 to 0 silently.
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [OVERFLOW] Outstanding count exceeded max=4; accepting 5th transaction
expected_root_cause: The 2-bit counter (max value 3) wraps around to 0 when 4 transactions are outstanding, making it appear empty rather than full [17].
failure_log:
COUNT=3 (binary 11). Increment: COUNT=0 (wrap). AWREADY=1 (incorrectly).
UVM_ERROR: 5th transaction accepted.
